title: 第7章 那我就拿百十株天帝药来换第8章 陈长生 对我动手需要付出代价
slug: 沉睡万年醒来一掌拍碎禁地
content_zh:
巨鳄横在轮回海之上。
恐怖气息席卷天地，虚空乱颤。
它似死亡主宰，无比恐怖。
九头狮吓的狂缩脑袋。
不断吞咽口水。
它小心紧张的看向陈长生。
这位能对付得了巨鳄吗？
帝王境啊！
帝中称王之境！
大帝在其面前不堪一击。
帝王境可随意拍杀掉大帝！
尤其这头巨鳄，还非普通帝王兽。
其俨然更加恐怖！
它也不免的紧张起来。
毕竟陈长生前面战绩虽猛。
但对方境界全在帝王境之下。
“杀！”
巨鳄冷哼，滔天杀意锁定陈长生。
刹那间——
无边恐怖力量向陈长生轰杀过去。

帝王境法则交织。
巨鳄出手凶猛，未曾小觑陈长生。
它动用出来的力量，足可绞杀掉帝王境生灵。
咚——
陈长生向前迈步，天地巨颤。
向他轰击过来的无边恐怖力量，瞬间全部消散。
“我来友好借血，不想动武。”
他说道：“我不白借血，会用天材地宝进行交换。”
巨鳄瞳孔猛缩。
一步踏出，竟令它轰过去的力量，消散全无？！
它倒吸了一口冷气。
盯着陈长生看了又看。
陈长生俨然不好对付，是一个很猛的狠茬子！
不过。
它并不怕！
主子就在轮回海中。
它有什么好怕的？
“换血？呵呵…凭你也配！”
它冷声斥喝，道：“你还是留下来给主子当血食吧！”
轰隆一声。
content_en:
The giant crocodile lies across the sea of ​​samsara.
The aura of terror swept across the world, and the void trembled.
It is like the Lord of Death, extremely terrifying.
The nine-headed lion shrank its head in fear.
Keep swallowing.
It looked at Chen Changsheng cautiously and nervously.
Can this one deal with the giant crocodile?
The imperial realm!
The realm of king among emperors!
The emperor was vulnerable before him.
In the imperial realm, you can shoot and kill the emperor at will!
Especially this giant crocodile is no ordinary imperial beast.
It seems even more terrifying!
It also became nervous.
After all, Chen Changsheng's previous record was fierce.
But the opponent's realm is all below the imperial realm.
"Kill!"
The giant crocodile snorted coldly, targeting Chen Changsheng with overwhelming murderous intent.
In an instant——
The boundless terrifying power blasted towards Chen Changsheng.
The laws of the imperial realm are intertwined.
The giant crocodile attacked fiercely and never underestimated Chen Changsheng.
The power it exerts is enough to strangle an emperor-level creature.
Boom——
Chen Changsheng stepped forward, and the world trembled.
The boundless terrifying power that bombarded him dissipated instantly.
"I'm here to lend blood in friendship, and I don't want to use force."
He said: "I don't borrow blood in vain, I will exchange it with heavenly materials and earthly treasures."
The giant crocodile's pupils shrank sharply.
One step forward, and the power it blasted away completely dissipated? !
It gasped.
He stared at Chen Changsheng again and again.
Chen Changsheng seems to be difficult to deal with, he is a very fierce and ruthless person!
but.
It's not afraid!
The master is in the sea of ​​reincarnation.
What's there to be afraid of?
"Exchange blood? Haha... you deserve it!"
It scolded in a cold voice and said: "You should stay and serve as blood food for the master!"
There was a boom.
